reason: One web search returned nothing useful on the 11-06 tape, so this rests on the packet, not on research. The book is 34% cash after the GDX stop. KRE is flat at +0.3% and XBI is -3.8%, both well inside their -12% and -15% stops. The picture is a broad selloff in which regional banks held up, and I have no evidence the thesis is broken. Selling would only add churn, and re-adding to the closed GDX leg would repeat a failed trade, so I hold with the existing stops.
